sensoryMethod: Sensory levels are editorial planning estimates based on the specific published conditions, not medical ratings or promises. Low means reduced stimulation, moderate means some ongoing music or activity, high means a likely stimulating mix, variable means conditions or parts of the visit differ, and unknown means evidence is insufficient. Sensory-friendly and disability-inclusive are not automatic low-sensory ratings. Earlier event verification dates remain visible.
